newsitem.title: HUNGARY: TRADERS RENEW BASKET DEALS ON HUNGARY FX FUTURES.
newsitem.headline: TRADERS RENEW BASKET DEALS ON HUNGARY FX FUTURES.

text.p: Dealers on Hungary's forex futures markets renewed ther recent hedging on the dollar/mark by completing basket deals in the two currencies as the dollar renewed its rise after weekend falls, dealers said on Tuesday.

Basket deals, by which dollars and marks are traded in the 30/70 proportion they represent in the central bank's currency basket against which the forint floats, are seen as a way of hedging against large dollar/mark fluctuations.
Modest turnover of 3.73 billion forints on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) was almost completely taken up by basket deals for December 1997 and March 1998.
The December mark fell 0.15 forints to 114.85 while the dollar rose 0.96 to close at 199.26.
The March mark fell 0.30 forints to 118.70 while the March dollar rose 0.75 to 205.00.
The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) saw only one trade for December 1998 worth 325 million forints.
